full_page.content:
1912
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 9 Cont.
Jan. 17th His Eminence John Card. Farley returned from Rome .... Altogether Sixty-one persons from the school and Monastery went to the Cath-dral to see him. These included Rev. Fr. Burchman, -Solanus, 8 sisters, 9 students and the rest Altar boys & Singers. We made a visit to Jesus on leaving Cathedral and asked Him to be with us
Page 10 on our journey home and the the subway trains were packed like sardines, we all got on both on the local at 50th St. and the Express at 72nd A special trolley took us home Deo Gratias !- Celebration Magnificant.
Jan. 18 Dedication of Rev. Paul Watson's Chapel of St. Francis at Graymoor on Hudson. Fr. Sol. went thither and in the evening gave Benediction and exhorted -Br. Chris- tophers.
Jan. 20 Annual report of parish progress read at all the Masses. "Banquet" and meeting of Honorary Servers - Trustees
Jan. 25 Cardinal John Farley honored by prelates and clergy from far and near. Card. Gibbons and 21 other bishops were present with about 50 monignori and many hundreds of priests.
Jan. 26 -Snap-shot of Capuchin Friars Minor appeared in the World of Jan. 26th in connection with reports of cele- bration the day prevous.
Jan. 27 Altar boys started to pray the Litany of Loretto at their weekly meetings, hoping thereby to gain favor with Our Lady of Perpetual Help in choosing their pro- per vocations.
Jan. 27 Sad accident with gun. Former Altar boy, Fr. Keegan while after a rat with his Father accidently discharged the gun from which his Father died the following Sunday night - resigned to God's will and well prepared with - Sacraments. Poor Frank was nearly heart broken.
